headline: Prism Johnson releases Q2 and H1 financial results
hook: Prism Johnson reports September quarter financials
summary: Prism Johnson Limited has filed its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year period ending September 30, 2026. The company submitted these documents to the National Stock Exchange as part of its mandatory regulatory compliance. Shareholders can now access the detailed performance metrics for the specified period through the exchange portal.
why_it_matters: Quarterly performance data helps assess the company's current financial health.
